name: Paper Boat
description: Paper Boat is made by Hector Beverages Pvt Ltd, an India-registered private company filing with the MCA/RoC. Ownership note: a Tata Consumer Products majority stake is NOT confirmed in searchable sources — Tata reportedly explored acquiring Paper Boat in 2018, but founder Neeraj Kakkar denied any sell-out at the time. Confirmed backers are GIC, Sofina, A91 Partners, Catamaran and Peak XV (~$143M raised). Do not assert a Tata majority without a fresh MCA shareholding check.

marketing_spend.derivation: FY25 filings show selling & distribution costs of ₹58.47 crore, with advertising bundled into total expenses of ₹716.53 crore rather than cleanly isolated as its own line. Using selling & distribution as the best disclosed proxy, advertising specifically is estimated at ~₹25-45 crore as a subset of that figure for FY25.

business_updates.headline: FY25 return to profit (₹46 crore) after a heavy FY24 loss (-₹334.1 crore)
FY26 revenue crossed ₹760 crore but profit collapsed 96% to ₹2 crore on a higher cost base
Revenue mix shifting toward third-party traded goods (66% of FY25 revenue)
